mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_registration_mail_delivery_outbox (verification_id, idempotency_key, encrypted_payload, nonce, status, attempt_count, available_at, claimed_until, last_error_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{verificationId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{encryptedPayload}, #{nonce}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{availableAt}, #{claimedUntil}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT verification_id, idempotency_key, encrypted_payload, nonce, status, attempt_count, available_at, claimed_until, last_error_code, created_at, updated_at FROM t_registration_mail_delivery_outbox WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY available_at, verification_id LIMIT #{limit}
